## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-12-24: Form-of TRA filed as S-1 Exhibit 10.2
- 2014-02-07: IPO priced
- 2014-02-11: IPO closes; original TRA executed by Ladder Capital Corp, LCFH, and Continuing LCFH Limited Partners

#### REIT realignment and TRA amendment-in-effect

- 2014-12-15: 8-K and DEFA14A announce planned REIT election and TRA amendment
- 2014-12-31: REIT realignment effected; A&R TRA executed at 11:59:58 p.m. (filed Jan 5 2015 8-K Exhibit 10.4); LC TRS I added as obligor and Series REIT step-ups carved out
- 2015-02-26: Shareholders approve the A&R TRA at Special Meeting

#### Section 4.01 termination

- 2020-09-30: Remaining LP holders exchange all units for Class A common stock during Q3 2020
- 2021-02-26: 2020 10-K discloses Section 4.01 election; $0.9M Early Termination Payments executed or scheduled February–March 2021, satisfying the entire TRA liability
- 2022: 10-K confirms no remaining TRA liability

## Explanation

Ladder Capital Corp went public via an Up-C IPO on February 11, 2014 and executed the TRA concurrent with closing, agreeing to pay the Continuing LCFH Limited Partners 85% of cash tax savings the Corporation realized from Section 754 basis step-ups arising on exchanges of LCFH LP Units for Class A common stock. Effective December 31, 2014, Ladder elected REIT status and restated the TRA to route payments through LC TRS I (the taxable REIT subsidiary) and to exclude Series REIT step-ups, structurally narrowing the tax-benefit pool while preserving the 85% rate; this kept the accrued liability under $2M for the contract's life. After the remaining LP holders exchanged their units in Q3 2020, the Corporation invoked Section 4.01 to compute Early Termination Payments, paying $0.9M in February and March 2021 and extinguishing the contract's economics under its own terms without a separately executed termination instrument. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
